caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with the lid open and the closed lid shown separately below. The interior side of the open lid features a painted image of a large white sailing ship with three masts and several sails, with a blue background occupying the inner surface of the lid. The outside of the chest is brown and features carved decorative patterns, including a wavy line with loops running across the front and a rectangular inset in the center, which appears to represent a mirror or piece of glass with visible cracks or divisions. The separate closed lid shown at the bottom is decorated with three carved five-pointed stars enclosed in circles that are set within rectangular borders filled with triangular patterns, all rendered in a brown color. The overall color palette of the drawing consists of various shades of brown for the chest, white for the sails of the ship, blue for the background of the painting on the lid, and a muted, off-white background for the drawing itself. The artist's signature, "Addl Brooks," is visible at the bottom right of the image.
title: Bishop Hill: Salt Box
